# Listenpad / 리슨패드

> A free, ad-free local language-listening practice player with no account
> and no subscription. Pick one audio file on this device and drill it:
> one-tap 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 second rewind and skip, A–B loop, playback speed
> from 0.5× to 1.5×, a scrubber with time labels, and listening notes kept
> per file name. Big buttons sized for a phone.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://listenpad.try-dabble.com/
The audio file is opened straight from this device and is never uploaded;
settings, loop points and notes stay in this browser on this device. No
accounts, no sign-in, no server-side copy, no ads, no in-app purchases, no
recurring charge. Rewind, loop and speed are all free. It is a drill player
for one file at a time, not a music library: no playlists, albums or queue.
Export a JSON backup (settings and notes only, no audio) to survive a
reinstall or move phones.

## Features

- Pick a file or drop one: MP3, M4A/AAC, WAV, OGG, FLAC and anything else the browser can play
- Big Play / Pause
- Four one-tap rewind buttons (1s, 2s, 3s, 4s) and four matching skip-forward buttons
- A–B loop: Set A, Set B, Clear; playback jumps back to A when it reaches B; markers on the scrubber
- Speed chips 0.5× to 1.5× with Reset 1×; pitch is preserved
- Scrubber with current time and duration
- Listening notes per file name, autosaved on this device
- Last rewind amount, speed and A–B points remembered; notes return when the same file name is opened again
- Keyboard: Space plays / pauses, ← and → rewind / skip by the last amount tapped
- On iPhone Safari the file must be picked again after a reload; notes and loop points for that file name come back
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker (cache listenpad-v1)
